lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a roughly linear longitudinal pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting the lateral flank, creating a grid-like framework where blobs are positioned between or atop the vertical stripes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Prominent longitudinal ridges along the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).
